name: Followed
text: Investigate. Choose an enemy at your location. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation for each damage on the chosen enemy (to a maximum of +5 [intellect]). If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the chosen enemy.
text_cn: 调查。选择你所在地点的一名敌人。所选敌人上每有1点伤害，这次调查你+1[intellect](最多+5[intellect])。如果你成功，在此地点发现额外1个线索。此行动不会引起所选敌人的趁乱攻击。
